idempotencyKey.description: Optional client-chosen key that makes recording this event safe to retry. Keys are scoped to the authenticated caller (organization and user), never to the client-settable `owner` field, so `owner` may be omitted without affecting deduplication. The first event a caller records with a key is kept, and a later create with the same key records nothing and answers 200 with that event, whatever the rest of the payload says. Use a value that names the occurrence, for example a run id, so a client replaying a local queue after a timeout never records a duplicate. Omit it for events that need no deduplication.
